cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5...3.20)

project(boost_hub VERSION "${BOOST_SUPERPROJECT_VERSION}" LANGUAGES CXX)

add_library(boost_hub INTERFACE)
add_library(Boost::hub ALIAS boost_hub)

target_include_directories(boost_hub INTERFACE include)

target_link_libraries(boost_hub
  INTERFACE
    Boost::assert
    Boost::config
    Boost::core
    Boost::throw_exception
)

if(BUILD_TESTING AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test/CMakeLists.txt")

  add_subdirectory(test)

endif()
